title: actionlint-check telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the actionlint-check hook. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "actionlint-check". Evolves additive-only.

tool.description: Claude Code tool that triggered the hook (Write or Edit).

file.description: Path of the checked GitHub Actions workflow file, relative to the consuming repo root.

findings.description: actionlint findings remaining for the file, one per line. Empty array = clean.
